dataList.content:
A crimson flame burst out.
鲜红色的火花噼里啪啦地燃烧起来。

The sword-bearing child fell on his rear in shock, and the one wearing gauntlets reached out to help.
持剑的孩子吓得跌坐在地，一个戴着金属护手的孩子向他伸出了手。

By striking the right spot at the right time, the Liu’s equipment can start a fire.
在正确的时机击中正确的部位，六协会的装备就能够产生火焰。
dataList.title:
Liu Section 6
六协会 6科

dataList.content:
The taciturn child spoke to the one who collapsed on the floor, extending an arm equipped with his extinguished gauntlet.
沉默寡言的孩子对摔倒在地的孩子这样说道，向他伸出了手，金属护手上缭绕的火焰刚刚散去。

On the other hand, nothing will be kindled if the trajectory and friction aren’t right. Fire cannot ignite by its lonesome.
反之，如果没能经过正确的轨迹和摩擦，就不可能燃烧起来，毕竟火焰也不会自己点燃。
dataList.title:
Liu Section 6
六协会 6科

dataList.content:
I have been taught that this law guides all of the Liu; thus, fire will naturally spark, just as I naturally still remain in Section 6.
这条指引着六协会所有人的法则也曾教导过我。正因如此，火焰才会自然产生，正如我自然而然地留在6科，直至今日。
dataList.title:
Liu Section 6
六协会 6科

dataList.content:
The confused child tilted their head as if a question still remained, while the one who answered looked at them with a faint smile.
困惑的孩子歪着头，好像没想明白。而回答者看着他，露出了淡淡的微笑。

Devote yourself to practice.
得更加努力练习才行。
dataList.title:
Liu Section 6
六协会 6科

dataList.content:
With that, the child left.
说完，这孩子就离开了。
